jobs.title: Senior Strategist (Brand & Creative)
jobs.description:
Boldspace are looking for someone with a strong track record in brand and integrated creative strategy, able to guide creative thinking, shape strategic direction for clients, and lead integrated strategic processes from insight through to execution. You should be comfortable acting as a trusted voice to clients and internal teams alike, helping define challenges, uncover opportunities, and develop work that delivers meaningful commercial and brand impact. A background spanning both brand and creative strategy is preferred, though not essential.

ABOUT BOLDSPACE

Boldspace is a brand value & creative agency. We help organisations grow their meaning, reputation and value through brand building, communications and analytics.

At our core is a combination of strategic thinking and creative advisory, helping clients move into new territory through brand campaigns that spark conversations and build reputation with the audiences that matter most. We are passionate about helping brands find their bold space: the unique territory where they are relevant, their audience cares, and they have the right to lead.

Since launch in 2020, our blend of strategy, creativity and technology has delivered positive impact for a diverse set of clients, including the Post Office, VISA, TGI Fridays, Deel, Virgin, Direct Line, Lovehoney, Boylesports and many more.

We are also the creators of Boldstream, our proprietary agentic AI SaaS platform designed for modern marketing and communications teams. Boldstream combines multi-LLM technology, integrated data and more than 100 specialist AI agents to support strategy, creativity, content and communications workflows in one connected system. The platform is used by live customers as well as internally by our own teams to help deliver smarter, faster and more effective work.

REQUIREMENTS

Lead strategic direction

Understand client businesses, audiences and objectives to help define clear strategic opportunities and solutions
Lead strategic thinking across accounts, helping shape both long-term brand direction and campaign development
Take ownership of strategic processes from briefing through to delivery and evaluation
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, building confidence through clear thinking, strong communication and commercial understanding
Identify opportunities for client and account growth, and contribute proactively to wider business development conversations
Set clear KPIs and success measures for strategic and creative work

Develop insight-driven thinking

Use a combination of quantitative and qualitative inputs to uncover meaningful insights and inform strategic recommendations
Be fluent in interpreting audience, cultural and market signals to shape compelling strategic responses
Lead stakeholder conversations and workshops that help uncover opportunities, align teams and inspire creative development
Stay informed on cultural, category and behavioural trends, translating these into relevant and actionable thinking for clients
Use tools including Boldstream and additional data sources to support strategic development and campaign effectiveness

Shape strategy and creative outputs

Contribute to the continued evolution of Boldspace’s approach to brand and communications strategy
Build clear strategic frameworks, positioning territories and communications platforms
Work closely with creative teams to develop ideas rooted in audience understanding and brand ambition
Craft compelling narratives, strategic presentations and client-facing materials
Identify key opportunities and friction points across brand and customer journeys
Support thought leadership initiatives including white papers, effectiveness case studies and agency marketing materials where relevant

YOU

Around 6+ years’ experience in an agency-side strategy, planning or brand role
Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to balance commercial, creative and audience perspectives
Confident working across both brand and campaign strategy
Quantitatively and qualitatively fluent, with the ability to interpret data and insight without relying heavily on formal research processes
Comfortable leading conversations with senior clients and presenting strategic recommendations clearly and confidently
Organised and adaptable, able to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
Strong written communication skills and experience creating polished client presentations
Curious about culture, behaviour and communications, with a natural instinct for spotting opportunities
Excited by the opportunity to work across both ambitious challenger brands and larger global accounts

BENEFITS

Pensions: a 5% employer contribution.
Holiday: unlimited holiday (including all UK public holidays) - we trust our staff to take the time they need and still excel in their jobs - and days off for birthdays and moving house are guaranteed!
Flexible working: 2/3 days per week in Soho office
Regular salary reviews: in line with a salary framework, to ensure equal pay for equal work and that we recognise and reward when your responsibilities increase.
Socials: team socials regularly, chosen by the team.
Team retreats: time to get to know each other away from the office.
Bonus: transparent bonus structure where you can receive a % of base salary based on personal and company performance.
Supporting good causes: we contribute some of our outperformance to charitable causes which the team help choose.
Wellness: time within working hours every week for those that want or need it.
Monthly benefits budget: £50 per month, every month, to spend on whatever you want - from a home delivered vegetable box and discounted gym memberships, to mental health support and professional coaching

A CARBON NEUTRAL BUSINESS

Boldspace (B Corp) measures its performance on profit, people and planet combined. From day one, we will offset your carbon footprint entirely. The cost of this is covered 100% by the company.

jobs.title: AI Creative Specialist | jij maakt beeld en video met de blik van een fotograaf | 2 vacatures
jobs.description:
Vacatureomschrijving

Je ziet wanneer het licht niet klopt. Wanneer een stof te glad oogt, een schoen zijn vorm verliest of een camerabeweging onnatuurlijk voelt. En je kunt uitleggen wat er moet veranderen om het beeld wél te laten werken.

Als AI Creative Specialist bij Omoda Brands gebruik je die vakkennis om foto- en videocontent met AI te produceren. Je helpt onze AI-productie opzetten: van productreferentie en briefing tot een consistente serie beelden die past bij het product, het kanaal en het merk.

Wat een AI Specialist Creatie bij ons is

Je combineert kennis van fotografie en visuele productie met praktisch gebruik van generatieve AI. Je begrijpt hoe een goed beeld wordt opgebouwd en kunt die keuzes vertalen naar referenties, instructies, instellingen en nabewerking.

Je maakt zelf content met AI en beoordeelt het resultaat. Belichting, perspectief, compositie, styling en materiaalweergave zijn voor jou concrete middelen om een beeld te sturen.

We maken al productbeelden met AI. Jij helpt ons om reproduceerbare productiewerkwijzes te maken voor Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com. Daarbij bewaak je het eigen karakter van ieder merk, binnen de bestaande creatieve richting.

Wat je doet

Je produceert met AI beeld- en videocontent voor onder meer productpresentaties, outfits, interieurs en campagnes.
Je vertaalt briefings en merkrichtlijnen naar concrete keuzes in licht, compositie, achtergrond, styling, kadrering en beweging.
Je selecteert geschikte productbeelden en visuele referenties en bepaalt welke input nodig is om een betrouwbaar resultaat te krijgen.
Je werkt met bestaande AI-tools, stuurt de generatie gericht bij en combineert die waar nodig met fotografie, retouche en montage.
Je controleert of het product herkenbaar en correct blijft: kleur, vorm, verhoudingen, materiaal, prints, logo’s en details moeten overeenkomen met de referentie.
Je beoordeelt beelden op fotografische kwaliteit en merkstijl en corrigeert afwijkingen voordat ze worden aangeboden voor publicatie.
Je let bij video op natuurlijke beweging, montage en continuïteit: een product, persoon of kledingstuk moet gedurende de opname consistent blijven.
Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare werkwijzen, referentiesets en instellingen waarmee je ook een volgende serie op hetzelfde kwaliteitsniveau kunt maken.
Je legt vast hoe content tot stand komt en helpt collega’s met de werkwijze en kwaliteitscontrole.
Je test nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen concrete producties en beoordeelt of ze bruikbare kwaliteit en tijdwinst opleveren.

Een aantrekkelijk beeld moet ook het juiste product laten zien. Je herkent wanneer extra nabewerking, een andere aanpak of aanvullende fotografie nodig is.

Functie-eisen

Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com hebben ieder een eigen uitstraling en doelgroep. Jij kunt die verschillen herkennen en vertalen naar de content die je maakt.

Je werkt vanuit de creatieve kaders van het betreffende merk en stemt af met de betrokken creatieve collega’s. Je bewaakt dat een serie samenhangend blijft, ook wanneer er meerdere producten, formaten of varianten worden gemaakt.

Je kijkt daarbij zowel naar het afzonderlijke beeld als naar het geheel: klopt de stijl op een productpagina, binnen een campagne en naast de andere content van het merk?

Wat je meebrengt

Je hebt een stevige basis in professionele fotografie of visuele productie, bijvoorbeeld als fotograaf, retoucher, beeldmaker of artdirector met praktische productie-ervaring.
Je begrijpt belichting, compositie, perspectief, kleur en materiaalweergave en kunt benoemen waarom een beeld wel of niet werkt.
Je hebt ervaring met product-, fashion- of lifestylebeelden en kunt werken binnen verschillende merkstijlen.
Je hebt zelf beelden gemaakt met generatieve AI en kunt laten zien hoe je het resultaat hebt gestuurd en verbeterd.
Je beheerst beeldbewerking en retouche, bijvoorbeeld in Photoshop of vergelijkbare software.
Je hebt gevoel voor bewegend beeld en kunt onnatuurlijke bewegingen, montageproblemen en inconsistenties herkennen. Praktische ervaring met videoproductie of montage is een plus.
Je werkt nauwkeurig en kunt een goed resultaat vertalen naar een werkwijze die opnieuw bruikbaar is.
Voor deze functie is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal vereist.

Je hoeft niet ieder AI-model of iedere tool te kennen. We zoeken iemand die weet wat goede fotografie en video zijn en die met AI kan leren realiseren. Je portfolio en inhoudelijke oordeel wegen zwaar. Programmeren is geen vereiste.

Aanvullende informatie

Je team

Je maakt deel uit van het AI-team en werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit creatie, fotografie, studio, content en de verschillende merken. Jij brengt het fotografische en creatieve vakmanschap en ontwikkelt de praktische werkwijze in de beschikbare tools. Voor maatwerksoftware, complexe automatisering of technische integraties werk je samen met AI Product Builders en AI Engineers.

Over Omoda Brands

Omoda Brands is het huis achter Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com. Vier merken, ruim 2.000 collega’s en meer dan 3 miljoen klanten per jaar. Onze ambitie is de meest persoonlijke boutique op schaal. Beeld helpt klanten daarbij: het laat zien hoe een product eruitziet, hoe je het combineert en hoe het past in je leven. We maken al productbeelden met AI en willen die productie verder ontwikkelen. Jij helpt ons foto- en videocontent maken die aantrekkelijk, productgetrouw en herkenbaar is voor ieder merk.

Wat je bij ons vindt

Flexibel werken vanuit Zierikzee, Amsterdam of Zwolle. We komen gemiddeld 1 à 2 dagen per week samen op één van deze locaties.
32–38 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw voorkeur.
Een passend salaris op basis van jouw kennis, ervaring en de waarde die je meebrengt.
De kans om AI-productie voor vier bekende merken op te gaan zetten.
Concrete producten, creatieve briefings en beeldmateriaal om mee te werken.
Ruimte om je fotografische vakkennis toe te passen op nieuwe productiemethoden.
Samenwerking met creatieve collega’s en technische specialisten.
Zichtbaar werk dat klanten helpt producten te ontdekken en te kiezen.

Interesse?

Laat ons zien wat je hebt gemaakt en vooral hoe je daartoe kwam. Deel enkele relevante beelden of video’s, waaronder een voorbeeld waarin je AI hebt gebruikt. Wat was de briefing, wat was jouw eigen bijdrage en hoe stuurde je op fotografische kwaliteit, productgetrouwheid en merkstijl?

We zien graag hoe je van referentie of eerste versie naar het uiteindelijke resultaat kwam. Een compact portfolio, link of voor-en-na-voorbeeld is voldoende; in het gesprek gaan we er samen dieper op in. Je hoeft geen nieuwe opdracht voor je sollicitatie te maken of vertrouwelijk materiaal te delen.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben.
Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm
). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet
.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du willst in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas mit überzeugenden Creatives dazu beitragen, die Brücke zwischen klinischer Forschung und überzeugenden Botschaften für Patientinnen zu schlagen? Dich treibt die Frage um, warum bestimmte Gesundheitsbotschaften wirken, und du bist bereit, Ownership für die Insights und Prozesse zu übernehmen, die unsere gesamte Creative-Pipeline optimieren? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir suchen ab sofort einen Creative Strategist (w/m/d) für Kijimea. Du wirst Teil eines Teams, das Klarheit, Wissenschaft und Kundenverhalten konsequent in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Gemeinsam erschließen wir neue Wachstumschancen, indem wir kreative Konzepte systematisch testen und unsere Position als vertrauenswürdigste, datengetriebene Marke in der Kategorie Verdauungsgesundheit weiter ausbauen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du führst quantitative sowie qualitative Markt- und Zielgruppenanalysen durch, um Präferenzen, Motive und Bedürfnisse der Zielgruppen fundiert zu verstehen.
Du schreibst Direct-Response-Skripte für den Bereich Video-Content und nutzt dabei Storytelling-Elemente, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erzeugen und überzeugend zu argumentieren.
Du erstellst klare, datenbasierte Briefings für unsere Agenturpartner, damit überzeugender Content entsteht
Du tauchst tief in Performance-Daten ein und identifizierst, warum ein Creative gewonnen oder verloren hat – ob Hook, medizinischer Claim oder visuelles Format – und spielst die Learnings direkt in die Produktion zu-rück.
Du bringst proaktiv Ideen ein, die unsere Online-Kampagnenziele unterstützen und sich stringent in die Gesamtstrategie einfügen.

Dein Profil

Du hast ein Studium oder eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung z.B. im Bereich Kommunikationswissenschaften, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Journalismus oder Marketing.
Du konntest bereits mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrungen im Bereich Creative Strategy sammeln (idealerweise in einer Agentur oder in einem Start-/Scale-up) und möchtest deine Skills nun bei einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare Player weltweit einbringen und weiter ausbauen.
Du verstehst, dass Content auf Plattformen wie Meta oder Youtube ein entscheidender Performance Treiber ist und brennst dafür, neue Formate und Angles zu entwickeln und zu testen
Du arbeitest datenbasiert und gehst analytisch ins Detail; seien es kommerzielle KPI wie ROAS oder CPO, oder auch Klick-, Hook- oder Engagement Rates
Du arbeitest äußerst strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig.
Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Level) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2-Level).

Unser Versprechen

Wir bieten Dir einen vielfältigen, anspruchsvollen Job mit spannenden Aufgaben und einem breiten Spektrum an Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten! Unser innovatives Umfeld ermöglicht Dir Deine berufliche Entfaltung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, Verantwortung von Tag 1 an und den Freiraum, neue Wege zu gehen. Auf Dich wartet individuelles Learning und echte Sinnhaftigkeit – schenke mit Deinem persönlichen Beitrag Millionen von Menschen ein neues Leben!

jobs.title: Digital & AI Leader
jobs.description:
CareGlance cerca una persona per il ruolo chiave di responsabile della componente digitale, software e di intelligenza artificiale del prodotto CareGlance: dall'interfaccia operatore agli algoritmi di Machine Learning per l'elaborazione real-time dei dati/immagini, con l’uso dell'AI per il completamento del prodotto industriale hardware/software.

Chi siamo

CareGlance è una PMI innovativa italiana con un portafoglio di brevetti proprietari. Sviluppiamo sensori ottici basati su tecnologia Swept Source-Optical Coherence Tomography (SS-OCT) per il controllo qualità ad alta precisione dei processi di manifattura industriale.
La sede principale è a Milano, mentre a Bari stiamo sviluppando un polo dedicato alle competenze software e digitali, in collaborazione con università e istituti di ricerca.
Siamo supportati da investitori istituzionali e collaboriamo con partner industriali e centri di ricerca in Europa.

Il ruolo

Cerchiamo un/una Digital & AI leader che assuma la responsabilità della formazione / gestione della nuova area Digital, Software e AI di CareGlance. La persona si inserirà in un contesto multidisciplinare (fotonica, elettronica, meccanica, che necessitano di software per controllo e acquisizione dati/ricostruzione di immagini) e avrà il compito di trasformare i dati generati dai nostri sistemi in un prodotto digitale affidabile, semplice e industrializzabile, comprensivo di un’interfaccia utente evoluta.
Il ruolo prevede specifiche aree di azione:
1. Prodotto software e interfaccia utente
Portare a livello di prodotto industriale la parte software dei sistemi CareGlance: acquisizione dati, visualizzazione real-time, restituzione dei risultati. L'obiettivo è un'interfaccia operatore chiara, robusta, utilizzabile da personale non specializzato.
2. Algoritmi AI e Machine Learning
Guidare lo sviluppo e l'industrializzazione degli algoritmi di AI/ML che elaborano i dati provenienti dai sensori. La persona lavorerà con le risorse già presenti per svolgere tutte le attività di trasformazione dell’algoritmo di ricostruzione delle immagini (brevettato da CareGlance), validare i risultati e portare l'architettura verso tecnologie adatte ad un real-time industriale.
3. Costruzione e guida del team
Il/la Digital & AI Leader supervisionerà direttamente le risorse già operanti in azienda sullo sviluppo software e guiderà la selezione, l'inserimento e la crescita delle persone che entreranno nel polo di Bari.

Responsabilità principali

Selezionare, formare e far crescere le persone del team Digital & AI.
Definire l'architettura software e AI del prodotto CareGlance, in coordinamento con il System Lead e tutta l’area R&D
Coordinare lo sviluppo del software per il primo prodotto: controllo dispositivi, acquisizione dati, elaborazione real-time, visualizzazione risultati.
Progettare e implementare loop di auto-training su lavorazioni industriali.
Lavorare a stretto contatto con le competenze di fotonica, elettronica e meccanica di sistema.

Requisiti obbligatori

Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria dell'Automazione o discipline affini.
Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di prodotti software o soluzioni AI/ML in contesti industriali o di prodotto (con attenzione all’esperienza utente)
Competenze solide di programmazione in Python e nell'ecosistema AI/ML
Esperienza nello sviluppo e nella validazione di algoritmi di Machine Learning.
Capacità ' di comprendere gli algoritmi esistenti (incluso codice Matlab)
Buona conoscenza dell'inglese scritto e parlato.
Autonomia, concretezza, capacità di lavorare in un contesto imprenditoriale in evoluzione rapida.

Requisiti preferenziali

Esperienza con dati provenienti da sensori e dispositivi fisici, elaborazioni real-time o sistemi embedded.
Conoscenza di architetture GPU per l'accelerazione di algoritmi numerici.
Esperienza in startup o PMI innovative, in contesti multidisciplinari hardware + software.
Familiarità con tecniche di computer vision o signal processing applicate a contesti industriali.
Esperienza nella progettazione di pipeline di training continuo (MLOps, auto-labeling, feedback loop).

Sede e organizzazione

Sede principale: Milano, dove la persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con la direzione, il System Lead e il team R&D.
Il ruolo prevede la supervisione operativa del polo di Bari dedicato allo sviluppo software e digitale, con trasferte periodiche.
Modalità di lavoro ibrida (al termine del periodo di prova) e orario flessibile.

Cosa offriamo

Contratto a tempo indeterminato (CCNL Metalmeccanico)
RAL tra i 45.000 e i 50.000 euro. Disponibili a valutare profili anche maggiormente qualificati.
Un ruolo di leadership nella costruzione dell'area Digital & AI

jobs.title: AI Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Mission

Content für unsere Kunden entsteht bei yoursquares nicht mehr Stück für Stück, sondern über ein System, das du aufbaust. Sobald ein Creative bei einem Kunden zieht, lässt du daraus AI-gestützt binnen kurzer Zeit ein ganzes Set an Varianten entstehen – andere Hooks, neue Formate, kürzere und längere Schnitte – und bringst sie parallel in den jeweiligen Account. Jede Version bleibt klar auf die Marke des Kunden zugeschnitten, und was weiterläuft, entscheiden die Zahlen, nicht das Bauchgefühl.

Produktentwicklung & Workflows

Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt-Team unseren AI-Creative-Stack weiter und gestaltest Systeme, mit denen wir deutlich mehr hochwertige Werbemittel in kürzerer Zeit produzieren können.
Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Content, AI, Performance Marketing und Produkt und übersetzt operative Anforderungen in skalierbare Prozesse und Produktideen
Du musst dabei nicht jeden technischen Prozess selbst programmieren oder bauen. Entscheidend ist, dass du verstehst, was mit AI, Automatisierungen und modernen Tools möglich ist, wo technische Grenzen liegen und wie ein sinnvoller Workflow aussehen sollte
Wenn du Workflows, Automatisierungen oder Prototypen selbst bauen kannst: umso besser. Bei komplexeren Lösungen arbeitest du eng mit unserem Produkt- und Tech-Team zusammen und bringst die fachlichen Anforderungen ein

Automatisierte Content-Produktion

Du arbeitest täglich mit Tools wie Claude Code & Design, Make, Higgsfield. HeyGen, Midjourney, Runway, Nano Banana, und weiteren AI-Tools und verbindest sie sinnvoll miteinander
Du entwickelst Systeme, die aus Projektinformationen automatisiert unterschiedliche Paid-Social-Content, Videos, Landingpages und Creative-Varianten generieren können
Du automatisierst die Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Landingpages und sorgst dafür, dass aus wenigen Inputs möglichst schnell hochwertige, conversionstarke Seiten entstehen
Du entwickelst und automatisierst AI-Video-Workflows – von der ersten Idee über unterschiedliche Hooks und Szenen bis hin zu Varianten, Formaten und Cutdowns

Creative-Produktion & Performance

Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Paid Ads selbst – Static Ads, Video, Motion, Landingpages und neue Formate
Du liest unsere Performance-Dashboards selbst, erkennst Muster und übersetzt die Daten direkt in neue Creative-Hypothesen und Iterationen
Du analysierst unter anderem Hook Rate, CTR, Conversion Rate, CPL, CPA und ROAS und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um unsere Creative-Produktion kontinuierlich besser zu machen

Tooling, UX & Marktbeobachtung

Du gestaltest auch die UX/UI unserer internen AI-Tools und Workflows mit. Dein Anspruch: Komplexe Technologie muss so einfach werden, dass jede Person im Team sie intuitiv nutzen kann
Du beobachtest den AI-Markt kontinuierlich und erkennst früh, welche neuen Modelle, Tools und Workflows einen echten Vorteil bringen
Du testest neue Technologien schnell und pragmatisch. Wenn ein neues Tool unseren bestehenden Prozess deutlich verbessert, integrierst du es – statt an bestehenden Lösungen festzuhalten

Das Bringst Du Idealerweise Mit

Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Content, Creative, AI, Automation oder einem vergleichbaren digitalen Umfeld mit.
Du bist AI-Native. Claude, Prompting, Make und generative AI gehören für dich zum täglichen Werkzeugkasten und sind keine Buzzwords.
Tools wie Nano Banana, Runway, Midjourney oder vergleichbare Lösungen hast du dir idealerweise selbst beigebracht – und du beschäftigst dich bereits mit den Tools, die sie morgen ersetzen könnten.
Du verstehst nicht nur einzelne AI-Tools, sondern kannst erkennen, wie unterschiedliche Tools zu einem sinnvollen Workflow zusammenspielen.
Du hast Spaß daran, Prozesse zu automatisieren und stellst dir regelmäßig die Frage: Warum machen wir das eigentlich noch manuell?
Du kannst Creatives nicht nur automatisieren, sondern hast selbst ein gutes Verständnis für Design, Content, Paid Social und Conversion.
Du verstehst, was einen guten Hook, eine starke Ad und eine funktionierende Landingpage ausmacht.
Du kannst Performance-Daten lesen und daraus konkrete Entscheidungen ableiten. Für dich gehören Creative und Performance zusammen.
Geschwindigkeit ist für dich kein Widerspruch zu Qualität. Die Vorstellung, sehr große Mengen an Creative-Varianten zu produzieren und zu testen, motiviert dich eher, als dass sie dich abschreckt.
Gleichzeitig hast du einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch: AI-Output darf nicht billig oder beliebig nach AI aussehen.
Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und hast Lust darauf, Dinge aufzubauen, für die es noch keine fertige Anleitung gibt.
Du fühlst dich in einem schnellen Start-up-Umfeld wohl, übernimmst Verantwortung und möchtest Strukturen nicht nur nutzen, sondern aktiv mitgestalten.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

jobs.title: Creative Experience Director
jobs.description:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About Fever

At Fever, we create and produce experiences that bring millions of people together through culture, entertainment and live events. From globally scalable original productions to bespoke experiences for some of the world's leading brands, we're redefining how audiences engage with entertainment.

As our portfolio continues to grow, we're looking for a Creative Director who can transform opportunities into compelling, commercially viable experiences, whether that's imagining the next scalable Fever Original or crafting a unique concept for a strategic client.

About The Role

As Creative Director, you will lead the creative development of new live experiences across two complementary areas.

On one side, you'll help shape the future of Fever's Strategic Scalable Initiatives (SSI), creating concepts that can successfully launch and grow across multiple international markets.

On the other, you'll partner with Fever for Business to develop bespoke creative proposals for clients looking to deliver unique experiences for their employees, customers or brands.

You'll combine creativity with strategic thinking, translating briefs into compelling concepts that are both emotionally engaging and operationally realistic. Working closely with Production, Business Development and Project Management teams, you'll ensure ideas are ambitious enough to inspire while remaining grounded in production realities.

This role requires exceptional conceptual thinking, outstanding presentation skills and a strong understanding of experiential production.

What You'll Own

You will be responsible for:

Creating original concepts for scalable live experiences and strategic client opportunities.
Developing compelling narratives, guest journeys and creative frameworks.
Translating briefs into clear, visually engaging presentations and client proposals.
Validating concepts alongside Production teams to ensure feasibility and scalability.
Contributing to Fever's long-term pipeline of original experiences and creative capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Experience Concept Development

Create original concepts for live experiences and events across entertainment, culture and branded experiences.
Design compelling guest journeys, storytelling frameworks and immersive moments.
Translate market trends, cultural insights and client needs into commercially relevant concepts.
Develop scalable experience formats that can be adapted across different markets without losing their creative integrity.

Client & Business Development Support

Partner with Fever for Business and Commercial teams to respond to client briefs and RFPs.
Rapidly develop creative responses, mood boards, narratives and presentation decks.
Present concepts confidently to internal stakeholders and external clients.
Balance creative ambition with commercial objectives and client expectations.

Creative Strategy

Continuously explore emerging entertainment formats, technologies and consumer trends.
Identify opportunities for new scalable concepts that strengthen Fever's portfolio.
Contribute to the creative vision and long-term evolution of Fever Originals.
Help define creative methodologies, templates and best practices across the team.

Production Collaboration

Work closely with Production teams to validate concepts throughout development.
Understand production constraints and adapt creative ideas accordingly.
Ensure concepts are exciting, executable and financially viable.
Support early feasibility discussions by considering venues, technology, logistics and operational complexity from the outset.

Communication & Storytelling

Build high-quality presentations that communicate ideas clearly and persuasively.
Structure narratives that resonate with both clients and internal stakeholders.
Translate complex creative ideas into simple, engaging stories.
Inspire confidence through clear communication, visual thinking and strategic recommendations.

About You

You're a highly conceptual creative who enjoys solving problems through experiences. You're equally comfortable starting with a blank page or responding to a demanding client brief, and you know how to turn ideas into compelling stories that people immediately understand.

You naturally think about both creativity and execution—asking not only "Is this exciting?" but also "Can we actually build it?"

You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities shift quickly, and you're energised by working across multiple industries, brands and entertainment formats.

Required

Experience & Skills

5+ years of experience developing live experiences, immersive productions, exhibitions or branded activations.
Exceptional conceptual thinking and storytelling abilities.
Strong experience building high-impact client presentations and pitch decks.
Excellent visual communication skills and design sensibility.
Understanding of experiential production and the ability to assess creative feasibility.
Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams including production, commercial and design.
Strong presentation and communication skills with senior stakeholders and clients.
Ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional quality.

Preferred

Experience responding to RFPs or competitive pitches.
Experience creating branded experiences for corporate clients.
Knowledge of immersive technologies, interactive experiences or emerging entertainment formats.
Experience working with international markets or globally scalable productions.
Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Keynote or similar creative presentation tools.

Who You Are

Curious and culturally aware, constantly exploring new ideas, formats and trends.
A natural storyteller with exceptional creative judgement.
Fast, structured and comfortable working under tight deadlines.
Commercially minded, understanding that great ideas also need to succeed as a business.
Collaborative and ego-free, bringing together different perspectives to create stronger work.
Comfortable moving between blue-sky ideation and practical execution.
Passionate about creating experiences that audiences remember long after they've left.

Why You'll Love It Here

40% discount on all Fever events, festivals, immersive experiences, and plans.
Attractive compensation package along with hybrid and remote-friendly flexibility.
Premium office location right in the heart of Madrid, complete with free snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit.
Flexible remuneration options with 100% tax exemptions through Cobee, plus Gympass, TaxDown, and early salary access via Payflow.
Comprehensive health insurance and company-sponsored language lessons.
Responsibility from day one with clear, structured pathways for professional and personal growth.
Vibrant work environment collaborating with a young, international, and exceptionally talented team.

Our Hiring Process:

A 30 min video call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers, to better understand your career plan, assess cultural fit and answer any questions you may have
A 60 min online test with three topics: logic, analytics and written understanding
A 30 min conversation with your future manager
A 45 min video call with your future manager, including questions about your profile and a business case presentation (to be prepared in advance)

On average our process lasts 20 working days and offers usually follow within a week.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

und verbinden klassische Filmproduktion zunehmend mit Generative AI.

Dafür suchen wir einen AI Video & Creative Producer (m/w/d)
, der KI nicht nur als Tool kennt, sondern kreativ damit arbeiten und aus Ideen überzeugende Szenen und Filme entwickeln kann.

Aufgaben

Du entwickelst mit Generative AI eigenständig Videos, Filmszenen, Charaktere, Avatare und visuelle Konzepte
– von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Ergebnis.

Dabei arbeitest du je nach Projekt unter anderem mit:

AI Video Generation

AI Image Generation

Avataren und Digital Humans

Character Creation & Animation

Voice AI und Lip Sync

Generative VFX

AI Editing und Postproduktion

Upscaling und Video Enhancement

Kombination verschiedener KI-Tools zu effizienten Produktions-Workflows

Du kennst gängige Tools wie beispielsweise Runway, Veo, Kling, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, HeyGen oder ElevenLabs
– oder vergleichbare Systeme.

Du musst ausdrücklich nicht jedes Tool kennen
.

Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du verstehst, welches Tool für welche Aufgabe geeignet ist, neue Technologien schnell einschätzen kannst und weißt, wie daraus ein professionelles Ergebnis entsteht.

Du denkst nicht nur in Prompts – du denkst in Szenen.

Das ist für uns entscheidend.

Wir suchen keinen reinen KI-Operator, der einzelne Clips generiert und anschließend zusammenschneidet.

Wenn du eine Szene entwickelst, denkst du darüber nach:

Was passiert?

Was sieht der Zuschauer?

Welche Einstellung brauche ich?

Wie bewegt sich die Kamera?

Was macht die Figur?

Welche Emotion soll entstehen?

Wie entwickelt sich die Szene?

Wie fügt sie sich in den gesamten Film ein?

Du solltest ein gutes Gefühl für Bildsprache, Szenenaufbau, Timing, Dramaturgie und visuelles Storytelling
haben.

Du musst kein klassischer Regisseur sein.

Aber du solltest aus einer Idee selbstständig eine funktionierende visuelle Sequenz entwickeln können.

Wichtig ist uns auch: Konsistenz statt Zufall

Ein einzelner beeindruckender AI-Shot reicht für professionelle Produktionen nicht aus.

Du solltest verstehen, wie man:

Charaktere über mehrere Szenen konsistent hält

Bildwelten und Looks kontrolliert

Produkte korrekt darstellt

Referenzbilder und Keyframes nutzt

Kamerabewegungen gezielt steuert

AI-Material mit klassischem Film und Postproduktion verbindet

Kurz gesagt: Du solltest aus KI einen Produktionsprozess machen können – nicht nur gute Einzelbilder erzeugen.

Qualifikation

Must-have

praktische Erfahrung mit Generative AI für Video oder Content

Erfahrung mit AI Video Generation

Erfahrung mit Avataren, Digital Humans oder Character Generation

sicherer Umgang mit unterschiedlichen KI-Tools

sehr gutes visuelles Vorstellungsvermögen

Gefühl für Bildsprache und Gestaltung

Verständnis für Szenenaufbau, Timing und Storytelling

Fähigkeit, Projekte eigenständig von der Idee bis zum fertigen Ergebnis umzusetzen

Neugier auf neue AI-Technologien und neue Produktionsmethoden

Nice-to-have

DaVinci Resolve, Premiere oder After Effects

Editing und Postproduktion

Motion Design / VFX / Compositing

Kamera- oder Produktionserfahrung

Voice AI

ComfyUI

APIs, Automatisierung oder AI-Workflows

Benefits

Die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau eines innovativen KI-Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.

Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Unternehmenskultur.

Kostenfreie Getränke, eigener Foodtruck und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Kostenfreie Getränke, frische Verpflegungsangebote und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Was du bei uns machst

Du arbeitest an realen Kundenprojekten und setzt Generative AI dort ein, wo sie echten kreativen oder produktionstechnischen Mehrwert schafft.

Das kann beispielsweise sein:

Ein Produktfilm mit AI-generierten Szenen.

Ein Imagefilm mit einem digitalen Charakter.

Eine Kampagne, die Realfilm und Generative AI miteinander verbindet.

Ein vollständig AI-generierter Film.

Oder ein Format, das es heute vielleicht noch gar nicht gibt.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele KI-Effekte einzubauen.

Es geht darum, mit KI bessere Filme, bessere Szenen und neue Produktionsmöglichkeiten zu schaffen.

Was wir von dir sehen möchten

Für uns ist dein Portfolio wichtiger als eine lange Tool-Liste oder dein Abschluss.

Multi-Shot-Szenen

eigene Filme oder Experimente

Kombinationen aus AI und klassischer Produktion

Editing- und Postproduktionsarbeiten

Auch persönliche Projekte sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Zeig uns nicht nur, welche Tools du kennst. Zeig uns, was du damit erzählen und produzieren kannst.

Kurz gesagt

Wir suchen jemanden, der KI versteht und visuell denkt.

Jemanden, der weiß, wie man einen Charakter erzeugt – aber auch, was dieser Charakter in einer Szene tun soll.

Jemanden, der einen starken Shot generieren kann – aber versteht, warum genau dieser Shot im Film gebraucht wird.

Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

We're building our own in-house content and creative team. jobs.description:
Location: Barcelona

About Us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.

We bridge digital and creative thinking, developing innovative work across skincare, healthcare, fashion, lifestyle, FMCG, and more. Our international teams in the US and Barcelona deliver results through smart strategy, sharp creativity, and meticulous execution.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Creative Director with strong conceptual thinking, great visual taste and experience working across global wellness and lifestyle brands.

Someone who can move comfortably between product and lifestyle, science and culture, and who understands how creative needs to work across the full consumer journey.

You might be working on a product with a complex ingredient or efficacy story one day, developing a talent-led campaign the next, and figuring out how that same brand idea translates into more product-focused or conversion-driven work further down the funnel.

This is a global role, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable developing ideas that can travel across markets and cultures without becoming generic.

You’ll lead creative development across global wellness, beauty-adjacent and lifestyle brands, from early concepts and campaign platforms through to production and execution.

We’re looking for someone who cares about the idea as much as the craft, but also understands what the creative is there to do.

You’ll work hand in hand with Strategy, as well as Copy, Design, Social and Production, to understand the audience, cultural context, role of each channel and each stage of the funnel, and translate that thinking into strong creative.

This isn’t purely an art direction role. You need to be able to come up with strong campaign ideas, build on other people’s ideas and turn them into something bigger.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong global campaign ideas and creative platforms that can live across markets, channels and executions.

Partner closely with strategists from the beginning of the process, challenging and building on briefs rather than simply receiving them.

Understand the role creative plays across the full funnel, from building awareness and brand desire to communicating product benefits, driving consideration and supporting conversion.

Know when an execution needs to build the brand, when it needs to explain the product and when it simply needs to make someone want it.

Turn strategy, product benefits and consumer insights into simple, relevant creative ideas.

Build global creative platforms that have a clear central idea while leaving enough room for markets to make them culturally relevant.

Lead the visual direction of brands across product, lifestyle, talent and culture-led work.

Find interesting ways to communicate ingredients, efficacy, innovation and science without everything suddenly looking clinical.

Make products feel desirable through photography, film, CGI, design, casting, styling and storytelling.

Bring product and lifestyle together naturally, rather than creating a beautiful lifestyle campaign and remembering the product at the end.

Develop ideas around talent, creators, partnerships and cultural moments that make sense for the brand and the market.

Think beyond traditional campaign formats and identify opportunities across social, experiences, collaborations, entertainment and emerging culture.

Lead work from concept through production, keeping the original idea and level of craft intact along the way.

Present and sell creative thinking to senior clients and stakeholders across different markets.

Lead and develop multidisciplinary and international creative teams.

What we’re looking for

A Creative Director who is conceptually strong and visually sophisticated, with a portfolio that shows range.

Big campaign thinking

Ideas with a clear point of view that can become genuine global platforms, not just a collection of executions.

Strong visual taste

A great eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and contemporary brand aesthetics.

Product storytelling

Experience making products, ingredients, technology or benefits interesting and desirable, especially when there’s real science or efficacy behind them.

Full-funnel creative thinking

An understanding of how people move from discovering a brand to considering and buying it, and how the creative job changes along the way.

Strong creative + strategy partnership

Someone who likes working closely with strategists, has a point of view on the brief and knows how to turn strategic thinking into creative opportunities.

Global thinking

Experience developing work for multiple markets and understanding the difference between a global idea and simply making the same campaign appear everywhere. You should be comfortable collaborating with local teams and adapting ideas around different cultural behaviors and audiences without losing the core creative thought.

Lifestyle and culture

Work that shows an understanding of how brands can play in culture through talent, creators, collaborations, social, entertainment and experiences.

Range

We want someone who can create a beautiful product or efficacy story and then switch gears into a culturally relevant lifestyle campaign without either feeling forced.

Key Requirements

10+ years of creative experience, ideally across agencies and/or ambitious consumer brands.

Significant experience working on global brands and international campaigns.

Experience leading integrated and full-funnel campaigns, from brand-building through product and conversion-focused creative.

Background in wellness, beauty, personal care, lifestyle, premium CPG or adjacent categories.

Experience working closely with Strategy on audiences, consumer journeys, cultural insights and creative briefs.

Experience working with product claims, ingredients, efficacy or science-led briefs is a plus.

Strong photography and film production experience.

Experience working with talent, creators or culturally driven campaigns.

Experience leading multidisciplinary and international creative teams.

Excellent client-facing and presentation skills.

Native or near-native English, or equivalent professional fluency developed through extensive experience working in English. This person needs to be able to concept, debate, present and sell creative ideas confidently in English with senior global clients and teams.

Portfolio

We want to see ideas, taste and range.

Showcase strong campaigns, as well as activations, social ideas, collaborations and product experiences that demonstrate different ways brands can connect with people.

We want to see work that feels relevant to its audience, where the product matters and the visual execution is strong.

Most importantly, your portfolio should demonstrate both sides of the profile: a genuine understanding of the Spanish market and meaningful experience working internationally.

Languages

English (mandatory)

Spanish (mandatory)

Any other languages are a plus.

What we offer

Remote flex Fridays from 9:00 AM to 2.30 PM.

Three weeks of remote work per year.

Summer working hours across July and August (9:00 AM to 4.00 PM).

Free English & Spanish classes to boost your global communication skills.

Access to Wellhub, a wellness platform offering a wide range of fitness and wellbeing options.

Flexible retribution plan for meals, transport and childcare.

Holidays: 22 working days + 3 days established by the collective agreement + national and local public holidays.

Bright, spacious offices in the heart of Barcelona.

Competitive salary with real growth opportunities.

A global environment, cutting-edge tools, and a culture driven by trends and innovation.

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As the Creative Director at Audible, you will be a critical part of our creative team and overall business. As the creative lead in our UK hub, you will work closely with partners across the company to translate strategic briefs into bold, fresh, culturally resonant creative. You will develop and deliver work across every customer channel and touchpoint, from original content campaigns to product launches and major brand initiatives. You will balance a globally minded vision, aligning with counterparts and peers across markets, with local relevance and nuance. Your leadership will be seen in the mentoring of junior teams, partnership with agencies, and in your own direct creative contributions.

You will lead the creative concepting, development and production of 360-degree campaigns for Audible Originals, Exclusives and third-party titles, including title key art, live action shoots, trailers and print. You will manage projects across their life cycle, from pitch to post-production. You will inspire and motivate your team, shepherding creative at all stages while providing guidance and direction.

About You

You are a driven, passionate creative at heart—a leader with the vision to help shape a brand’s evolution and the craft to execute it with excellence. You live and breathe culture and know how to make a brand stand out while staying true to its core values. You have deep experience in entertainment marketing as well as brand-forward campaigns. You understand how to balance global brand consistency with local cultural nuance. You anticipate production needs and manage workflows to achieve results while ensuring work is delivered on-time and on-budget. You are a hands-on leader who inspires teams and partners to push boundaries, delivering work that is strategically smart, emotionally compelling, and visually exceptional.

As the Creative Director, you will…

Define the overarching creative strategy for one or more marketing programs, leading internal and external teams to concept, develop, and execute 360-degree campaigns in support of Audible Originals, Exclusives and third-party titles across owned and paid channels, all platforms, and all media
Directly contribute to the development of high-impact brand campaigns, product launches, activations, and initiatives that build awareness and affinity for Audible
Focus on campaigns originating in the UK, with potential to expand to the Australian market and emerging markets
Direct and guide writing and production of key campaign assets including talent-led celebrity scripts, trailers, social-first executions, live action shoots, and key art
Guide and select external agency partners, directing their creative output at the highest level of craft while managing celebrity talent and high-profile partners across campaign milestones
Lead campaign presentations and pitches with internal and external partners, talent, and leadership, clearly articulating creative vision, strategy, and business rationale
Drive creative alignment across cross-functional stakeholders, influencing priorities and tactical elements owned by adjacent teams to ensure cohesive brand storytelling
Manage a high volume of overlapping projects and complex requests, effectively prioritizing across and up the organization while making creative trade-off decisions that balance team, business, and customer needs
Develop and optimize creative workflows and production processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and consistency, building mechanisms that support long-term operational excellence
Integrate cultural insights, audience research, and performance data into creative strategies, synthesizing disparate inputs into compelling campaign ideas and creative territories
Lead by example — mentoring and developing junior creatives, inspiring teams and partners to push boundaries, experiment, and challenge the status quo

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience
Portfolio demonstrating excellence in entertainment marketing, title key art, brand campaigns, and cross-channel creative execution
Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and familiarity with motion, digital, and emerging creative tools
Experience articulating both creative vision and strategy to multiple stakeholders and leadership
Experience collaborating with and directing external creative partners and agencies
Experience with experiential, OOH, and integrated campaign work
Experience directing live action and photo shoots

Preferred Qualifications

Deep understanding of the evolving digital and social media landscape
Experience working on entertainment, lifestyle, or consumer tech brands

Where your expertise is needed

AUTODOC is the largest and fastest growing auto parts ecommerce platform in Europe.

Present across 27 countries with around 6,000 employees, AUTODOC generated revenue of over €1.8 billion in 2025, supplying more than 9.3 million active customers with its millions of vehicle parts and accessories for car, truck, and motorcycle brands.

We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels a strong sense of

impact, purpose, and belonging—whether they are working in our offices, warehouses, or remotely.

With our headquarters in Berlin, and several offices across Europe, we are driving towards our vision

with a clear focus on leveraging technology to build a sustainable future for mobility.

Join us as we accelerate towards becoming the leading tech ecosystem in the automotive world.

Catch the ride with AUTODOC!

Job Description

About the role

AUTODOC is scaling fast, and creativity is one of the biggest levers we have to do it well. We're looking for a Head of Creative to lead the team that gives our brand its voice, look and feel — across content, campaigns and the wider company. You'll set the creative vision for the brand and ensure it is being upheld, and put in place the systems and ways of working that let this quality scale

What you'll own

Creative vision. Set the creative direction for AUTODOC's brand and communications, translating business and brand strategy into concepts, campaigns and ideas that hold together across every market and channel.

The team and the craft. Lead and grow the core creative design team — structuring, mentoring, and building a critique culture that raises the bar. Ensure business units and channels get creative partnership that understands its goals while staying consistent with the brand.

Quality at scale. Build the design system, brand guidelines and creative operating model — briefing, prioritisation, review — that let the team move fast and stay excellent across a high volume, multi-market output.

Business partnership. Work directly with Promotions, CRM, Private Brand, Internal Comms, Performance Marketing and Product to make sure creative resourcing and prioritisation reflect what the business actually needs, while representing the creative point of view to senior stakeholders with real credibility.

Modern creative practice. Champion the use of AI and emerging tools across the creative workflow — pushing speed and experimentation where it counts, while knowing where craft and human judgement stay non-negotiable.

Qualifications

What you bring

Substantial experience leading creative — in-house or agency-side — with real creative ownership, not just design management.
A clear point of view: you can present a creative position, defend it, and know when to change it.
Proven range across identity and brand systems, campaign concepts, performance and CRM creative, and motion.
Fluency in how brand-building and performance marketing work together.
Direct experience in DE, FR or UK markets, with the judgement to adapt to markets you know less well.
Credibility with senior stakeholders, including under commercial pressure.
Hands-on curiosity about AI and new tools in the creative workflow — not just interest, but actual use.
Working proficiency in English.

Fast growing international company with stable employment

Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval

Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)
Free English and German language classes (after probation period)
Flexible working hours and hybrid work

How to apply

Send your CV and portfolio. We're more interested in a small number of projects you can talk through in depth — the thinking, the constraints, what you'd do differently — than in volume.

From large-scale digital platforms and motion-led brand systems, to experimental storytelling powered by emerging tools, you’ll push the boundaries of what’s possible in digital creativity.

You’re a visionary creative leader who thinks like a filmmaker, builds like a technician, and creates like a storyteller, bringing together craft, innovation, and strategy to shape work that influences culture and elevates global brands.

As part of the AKQA team and based in our Amsterdam studio, you’ll work in an environment that fosters a dynamic and inclusive culture, enabled by our multidisciplinary approach and supported by some of the brightest minds in their field. You will report to the Creative Director and collaborate closely with team leads across the studio to continually inspire, innovate, and deliver work of the highest standard.

Deliver and lead award-winning work that meets client needs while influencing culture, blending art direction, design craft, and innovative use of technology.
Direct and Lead autonomous teams to bring cinematic vision, technical precision, and emotional storytelling into every project — thinking like a filmmaker, building like a technician, and creating like a storyteller.
Establish and direct creative foundations in concepting art directions for production and motion graphics, ensuring ideas are strategically sound and visually compelling.
Ability to direct specialised CGI artists across animation, modelling, rigging, lighting, and compositing to maintain creative cohesion and quality.
Apply craft knowledge across CGI workflows, including modelling, lighting, animatics, grading, and retouching.
Provide hands-on expertise in retouching, compositing, grading, and finalising large-scale projects, guiding teams through complex production pipelines.

Contribute to and lead the development of creative briefs, collaborating with clients and strategists to define opportunities and deliver visionary outcomes.
Collaborate across disciplines — including design, UX, and development — to integrate creativity, craft, and strategy seamlessly into final outputs.

Experienced in building and maintaining client relationships, growing partnerships through trust, creativity, and consistent delivery of exceptional results.
Exceptional communicator with the ability to craft and deliver compelling presentations, clearly articulating creative vision, rationale, and executional guidelines.
Recognised for representing your agency publicly—through talks, mentorship, or thought leadership—and inspiring both peers and the next generation of creatives.

Entwicklung und Herstellung erfolgen aus einer Hand an unserem Unternehmensstandort im hessischen Nauheim - für Kunden in Deutschland und weltweit.

Was uns auszeichnet: Der Anspruch, Dinge neu und anders zu denken - kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für persönliche Gestaltung. ‚Jeder Tag ist Deiner‘ ist hierbei kein einfaches Versprechen. Wir suchen kreative, kluge und erfahrene Persönlichkeiten, die mit uns das tägliche ‚Plus‘ an Gesundheit weitergeben – an Menschen, die das Besondere suchen und für die ein gesundes und erfülltes Leben besonders wichtig ist**.**

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle:

Unsere Produkte sind premium – und unser Markenauftritt soll es überall ebenso sein. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Als Creative Art Director gibst du ZEINpharma ein unverwechselbares Gesicht: von der Verpackung im Apothekenregal über den Amazon-Auftritt bis zur nächsten Kampagne. Du schärfst unser Markenbild kanalübergreifend, setzt kreative Standards und sorgst dafür, dass jedes Asset nach ZEIN aussieht.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:

Markenbild & Designsystem:
Verantwortung für den visuellen Auftritt von ZEINpharma sowie Weiterentwicklung von Brand Guidelines, Templates und unserem Designsystem über alle Kanäle

Packaging & Produktlaunches:
Gestaltung von Verpackungen, Etiketten und Produktlinien – von der ersten Idee bis zur druckfertigen Übergabe an Reinzeichnung und Druckerei, in enger Abstimmung mit Regulatory Affairs

Kampagnen & Content:
Entwicklung von Kampagnenkonzepten für Shop, Amazon und Marketplaces, Social Media, Newsletter sowie Apotheke und PoS inkl. Steuerung von Foto- und Videoproduktionen

Kreative Führung:
Kreative Richtung für Designer und externe Partner sowie Qualitätssicherung aller Assets

Text & Designkonzepte:
Verantwortung für die textliche Seite aller Assets, Entwicklung von Designkonzepten sowie enge Abstimmung mit externen Partnern und Agenturen

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

Abgeschlossenes Studium in Kommunikations- oder Grafikdesign oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung

Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Art Director oder Senior Designer – idealerweise in Agentur und/oder Inhouse im FMCG-, Health-, Pharma- oder Beauty-Umfeld

Aussagekräftiges Portfolio mit Packaging- und Kampagnenarbeiten

Sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop), Kenntnisse in Figma und fundiertes Verständnis von Druckvorstufe und Reinzeichnung

Gespür für einen Premium-Markenauftritt, Typografie und aktuelle Trends – Erfahrung mit E-Commerce-Assets wie Amazon A+ Content ist ein echter Pluspunkt

Offenheit für KI-gestützte Bild- und Contentproduktion (z. B. Adobe Firefly, Midjourney) als Werkzeug im Kreativprozess

Hands-on-Mentalität mit strategischem Blick: Du denkst Marke im Großen und setzt im Detail um – auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten

Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Die Chance, den Auftritt einer etablierten, wachsenden Marke sichtbar zu prägen – mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum

Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung

Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

50 % Mitarbeiterrabatt auf alle ZEINpharma-Produkte

Hochmoderne, neue Büroräume in Rüsselsheim mit ergonomischer, höhenverstellbarer Ausstattung

Mitarbeiterparkplätze direkt vor der Tür und kostenlose Getränke

Du möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden?

Wolltest du schon immer einer Marke im Gesundheitsmarkt ihr Gesicht geben – statt nur Vorlagen zu bespielen? Und legst du Wert auf ein innovatives und kreatives Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für persönliche Entwicklung?

jobs.title: Head of Brand
jobs.description:
About Us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance
.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint.

Here's What That Looks Like In Practice

Creative Production - Owning the production of creative assets, ensuring every output meets a consistently high bar of quality, craft, and brand consistency.
Brand Activation - Driving both ATL (TV, radio, OOH, print) and BTL/untraditional activations, bringing the brand to life in bold and memorable ways.
Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance.
Brand Strategy & Insights - Shaping and safeguarding brand identity, and grounding decisions in research and listening, including surveys with both customers and non-customers.
Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output.
Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches.
Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

Who We're Looking For

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."

10+ years of experience - Proven track record in brand management or creative direction, ideally within fast-growing tech companies or top-tier creative agencies.
Strong Technical & Visual Culture - Deep understanding of design systems, rebranding processes, and multi-channel campaign production (from social media to TV/OOH).
A "Hands-on" Leader - You love to lead by example. You're not just a "manager of resources" but someone who can get into the details of a layout or a script to ensure excellence.
Data-Informed Mindset - Ability to translate brand concepts into business objectives, utilizing KPIs and OKRs to measure impact and iterate quickly.
Exceptional Communicator - Fluent in English, with the ability to simplify complex brand visions for internal stakeholders and external audiences alike.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

Own outcomes that reach millions. Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day.
Operate in high-growth. You'll make high-stakes calls without waiting for perfect information, in an environment that changes fast as we launch and scale new products.
Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.
Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

About

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

Initial salary:
Starting from €65,000 gross per annum

This baseline is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent.
The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.

Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!
