jobs.title: Head of Brand Experience
jobs.description:
A career in Maison Valentino is your chance to grow in a reality where business and creativity meet and thrive in an inclusive, and open-minded community.

Maison Valentino believes in a colleague-centric approach, where our contribution and behaviors as individuals are the secret of our success as a community. Each Valentino colleague is crucial to guarantee that every need in Valentino is met with mastery, creativity, uniqueness, and care.

The Head of Brand Experience is responsible for developing and driving the Maison’s global Brand Experience initiatives through the creation of meaningful, culturally relevant, and emotionally engaging experiences that strengthen the connection between the Maison and its global communities.

The role plays an important part in continuously developing new experiential concepts, activation ideas, and engagement formats that bring the Maison’s seasonal narratives, product launches, and brand direction to life across global markets. Working within the Maison’s overall brand and communications strategy under the leadership of the CMO organization, the role helps ensure a continuous pipeline of elevated and impactful Brand Experience initiatives worldwide.

Reporting to the Director of Global Events and working closely with regional teams, Brand Image, and other key stakeholders, the role supports the ongoing development and rollout of seasonal experiential frameworks, creative guidelines, and activation concepts aligned with the Maison’s priorities and identity.

The position requires a highly creative and strategically minded profile with a strong understanding of luxury, hospitality, culture, entertainment, and community-building, paired with excellent organizational, collaborative, and project management capabilities.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

Develop and support the execution of the Maison’s global Brand Experience initiatives across all markets and key Maison moments.
Develop creative and strategically relevant experiential concepts that support the Maison’s seasonal narratives, product launches, client engagement initiatives, and cultural moments.
Create elevated and engaging experience formats designed to strengthen emotional connection, client engagement, desirability, and sense of belonging within the Maison’s universe.
Build seasonal experiential guidelines and activation frameworks for regional markets, ensuring consistency while allowing flexibility for local adaptation and cultural relevance.
Partner closely with regional marketing teams to provide creative guidance, ideas, and bespoke experiential solutions relevant to each market and audience.
Ensure all regional and local activations follow Maison standards, brand guidelines, approval processes, and strategic priorities established by the CMO organization.
Coordinate with the Creative Director’s office and Brand Image teams where relevant to ensure alignment with seasonal narratives, Maison image direction, and storytelling.
Work cross-functionally with Marketing, PR, Retail, VM, Clienteling, CRM, Brand Image, Partnerships, Digital and Graphics teams to ensure cohesive and impactful execution across all initiatives.
Develop and oversee experiential concepts for key Maison moments including fashion shows, product launches, client activations, cultural initiatives, private experiences, dinners, seasonal festivities, community-driven events, and regional activations.
Research and propose new collaborators, agencies, venues, creatives, hospitality partners, production suppliers, cultural partners, and experiential formats to continuously evolve and elevate the Maison’s Brand Experience offering.
Contribute to the continuous evolution of the Maison’s Brand Experience approach by identifying new opportunities to increase visibility, desirability, client engagement, and cultural relevance.
Ensure regions are consistently supported with fresh concepts, ideas, and activation opportunities to maintain continuous experiential output and engagement throughout the year.
Collaborate closely with the Event Planning team to align initiatives with business timelines, operational planning, and department budget parameters.
Support the integration and alignment of partnership initiatives within the wider Brand Experience strategy and activation calendar.
Participate in wider MarComm and regional alignment meetings to ensure experiential initiatives support broader communication priorities and business objectives.
Foster strong coordination and synergies across departments to ensure seamless execution and consistency across all experiential touchpoints globally.
Lead, mentor, and support the Brand Experience team, ensuring all projects are delivered with creativity, precision, collaboration, and operational excellence.
Track and evaluate the effectiveness and impact of Brand Experience initiatives through qualitative and quantitative feedback to support continuous improvement and evolution of the function.
Collaborate closely with L’Oréal and Kering Eyewear teams to ensure alignment and consistency across beauty experiences, launches, and image-related initiatives.

Profile & Requirements

Naturally curious and ideas driven profile with a strong instinct for what can create relevance, emotion and memorability around a luxury brand.
Significant relevant experience of at least 7 years within luxury, fashion, hospitality, lifestyle, culture or other premium environments, with exposure to experiental marketing, brand experience or activations.
Proven ability to develop original experiental concepts and ideas, trasnlating brand strategy, creative direction and seasonal narratives into compelling experiences.
Strong understanding of the luxury landscape and evolving client expectations, with a particular sensitivity to hospitality, culture and contemporary brand engagement.
Cultural curiosity and awareness with an instinct for identifying new ideas, collaborators, locations and formats that can enrich the Maison’s universe.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, timelines and budgets simultaneously.
Collaborative working style, with the ability to operate effectively across corporate and regional teams, as well as with external agencies and partners.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Fluent English, additional languages are an advantage.

What We Offer

Applicable National Collective Labor Agreement (CCNL): Tessile Industria
Category: Quadro
Indicative compensation: €70,000 - €80,000
Annual bonus opportunity in accordance with the Company's internal agreement
Benefits: in addition to those provided under the applicable National Collective Labor Agreement and by law, employees are eligible for further benefits and initiatives in accordance with Company policies, including smart working arrangements, meal vouchers, and private health insurance.

The Valentino ecosystem is home to a wide and extraordinary pool of talents, each colleague contributing with their unique attributes, nurturing a culture of inclusivity and equality. Inspiring sense of belonging, passion and engaging colleagues are the bases of our inclusive and multifaceted world.

jobs.title: Midweight AI Creative
jobs.description:
VCCP is the global challenger network for challenger brands. With more than 1,500 people across 13 offices in North America, EMEA and APAC, we challenge convention to create value for the world’s most ambitious organisations.

Our founding belief is It Only Works If It All Works. That’s why we bring specialists from every discipline - strategy, AI, data, media, digital, experience, branding, creativity, production, PR, CX, CRM, employee engagement and beyond - into one fully integrated challenger network.

We were founded on the principles of simplicity, collaboration and un-preciousness, and we’ve grown by staying true to them. Today, our clients include some of the world’s most recognisable and progressive brands, such as Virgin Media O2, Barclays, Cadbury, Compare the Market, Domino’s, White Claw, easyJet, Primark and Co-op.

VCCP has topped the AAR’s annual new business ranking in 13 of the last 14 years and holds multiple Agency of the Year titles. Across every company and every capability, we share the same ambition: to challenge ourselves, challenge our clients and challenge the industry for the better.

THE ROLE

Faith is VCCP's AI Creative Agency, a focused, fast-moving team of talent from around the wider agency building campaigns, experiences and tools that put Gen-AI to genuinely creative use for clients including Virgin Media O2, British Gas, Cadbury and easyJet.

We're looking for a Creative who treats AI as a way to challenge conventions and unlocknew, interesting experiences that make their work better; more than pumping out stuff quicker and cheaper.

You'll have a regular flow of briefs from one of the most enviable client lists in the UK to work from, but the best candidates won't stop there. We want someone who's constantly tracking what's new in AI: new models, new tools, new behaviours; and asking "what could we do with this for our clients?"

Being proactive is key to this role. VCCP is full of people, ready to help support and sell great ideas but initially you'll need to be comfortable working independently, developing your work to sell-in to your two managing Creative Directors, other teams across the agency, and to clients.

If you're already building passion projects with AI in your own time because you just can’t help yourself, let’s talk.

Key Responsibilities

Learning Mindset: Demonstrate a passion for the Gen-AI space and the ability to stay updated with the latest in AI, from video and image models, to agent frameworks.
Creatively Independent: Generating ideas proactively and from briefs focussed on Gen-AI and innovation.
Constantly Curious: Staying across the latest AI developments and constantly asking what they could unlock creatively for our clients.
Think it, build it: Building rapid proof-of-concept work at pace.
Good enough to communicate the idea, not precious about polish at this stage
Confident Communicator: Presenting concepts confidently to Creative Directors, internal teams, other agency verticals and clients.
Model Proficiency: Prompt engineering across LLMs and applied use of image/video/music models and agentic platforms; willingness to develop deeper expertise in ComfyUI and model training where relevant.
Collaborating: Work alongside our engineering team to integrate and refine AI models, aligning them with the agency's creative standards, tools and client requisites. Also helping traditional Creative Teams validate their AI ideas.
Upskilling the wider agency: Contribute to delivering training for different audiences across VCCP.

What We're Looking For

The balance that matters here is roughly 60/40 creative-to-technical. We care more about ideas and the confidence to push them than your GitHub.

Essential

Strong creative instincts with a demonstrable ability to generate original, AI-native ideas
Strong Art Direction background to inform quality image and video generations.
Confidence presenting and selling concepts verbally, in decks and in rooms
Solid working knowledge of LLMs, image generation models and prompt engineering
Self-motivation and entrepreneurial energy, you make things happen without being told to
Fast prototyping ability, you can mock something up well enough to communicate the idea
Comfort with ambiguity and a lean, independent way of working in this very fast moving AI tech space

Useful But Not Required

Experience with ComfyUI, Antigravity/Claude Code, OpenClaw/Hermes and custom model training experience e.g. training LoRAs
Python, API and MCP development experience
A background in design, advertising, digital or a related creative field
A degree in a relevant subject is fine, but we'd take a strong portfolio of self-initiated
AI work over a Computer Science certificate any day.

VCCP DE&I STATEMENT

We believe that DE&I is about creating a strong culture of inclusion within our agency, where everyone can thrive and be their authentic self. VCCP is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or ethnicity. If you require any adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know via joinus@vccp.com.

CRIMINAL RECORDS INFORMATION

As part of our onboarding process, you will be required to complete a Criminal Records Declaration regarding any unspent convictions. For roles in finance, HR, Legal, IT or senior management, we may be required to verify your declaration with a basic DBS check, as well as an Adverse Finance and ID check.

Please note, we try to respond to as many applications as possible but, if you do not hear from us within two weeks of submitting your application, please assume we are unable to proceed with your application for this specific role. Thank you for your interest in VCCP**

jobs.description:
ThinkMarkets is a global financial technology company specializing in multi-asset trading solutions. Through our flagship ThinkTrader platform, we provide clients worldwide with access to thousands of financial instruments across global markets, supported by advanced trading technology and infrastructure.

Backed by ThinkMarkets' market expertise and infrastructure, ThinkCapital is our prop trading evaluation business, providing aspiring traders with access to a broad range of trading products within a simulated trading environment. Our mission is to simplify the trading journey by combining smart technology with trusted support, giving traders the tools, education and opportunities to develop their skills and elevate their trading potential.

We are seeking a Creative Lead to join our Marketing team, taking ownership of creative for our growing prop trading business and strengthening its brand identity across channels. This is a hands-on creative role, responsible for translating business objectives into compelling concepts and high-quality visual and multimedia content that engages traders and supports our wider marketing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Development & Execution

Take a hands-on role in developing and executing creative concepts aligned with brand and marketing objectives.
Own the creative process from concept through delivery, ensuring quality and consistency across channels.
Provide creative direction, feedback and support to designers and other creative team members.
Use performance data, testing and emerging creative trends to continuously improve content and campaign effectiveness.

Digital, Video & Performance Creative

Develop digital-first creative for paid acquisition and performance campaigns, focused on driving engagement and conversion.
Develop engaging multimedia content across trading education, market insights, product, brand and trader-focused campaigns.
Create and oversee video-led content including promotional videos, interviews, tutorials and talking-head formats.
Adapt and localise creative across regions and languages while maintaining brand consistency.

AI & Creative Production

Use AI creative tools across ideation, design, image generation, video production and content development.
Use AI and automation to improve production efficiency and scale creative output without compromising quality.
Support AI-enabled creative workflows, including agents, integrations and automations where relevant.

Collaboration & Delivery

Work closely with Performance Marketing, Social Media, Content, CRM, Affiliates and wider Marketing teams to deliver creative against campaign and business requirements.
Manage multiple creative briefs and priorities within a fast-paced marketing environment.
Maintain strong attention to detail and quality control across all creative deliverables.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Digital Media, Marketing, Fine Arts, or a related creative discipline.
3–5 years of experience in creative roles, with experience leading creative projects and providing direction to other creatives.
Strong understanding of brand development, visual storytelling and creative strategy.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent industry-standard creative tools.
Experience developing digital-first creative across paid media, social, web and video.
Experience using AI creative tools within professional workflows.
Strong project management, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
A strong portfolio demonstrating creative thinking, storytelling and a broad range of digital work.

Preferred

Experience within trading, prop trading, fintech, gaming, betting or another high-growth digital consumer industry.
Experience developing or configuring AI-enabled creative workflows, including agents, integrations or automations.

Budapest

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

This role is part of our EMEA Creative & Media team. Our team is a vibrant mix of media talents, ranging from Creatives, Influencer Marketers, Brand & Content Strategists to Account Managers, Media Planners and Marketing Automation Consultants. Together, we blend imaginative storytelling and performance-driven strategies with cutting-edge technology to create engaging digital experiences that build lasting relationships with our clients like Logitech, Just Eat Takeaway, Foot Locker & Meta.

Job Purpose

The primary objective of the Creative Director is to build, lead, and develop the Hungarian creative team. This role will play a key part in establishing a strong, inspiring, and high-performing creative department that can independently support the company’s brand vision, business objectives, and creative ambitions.

The Creative Director will be responsible for defining the creative direction, building the right team structure, developing talent, and creating the processes and culture needed to deliver outstanding creative work.

What You’ll Do

Build the Hungarian creative department from the ground up, including team structure, roles, capabilities, and ways of working
Recruit, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing creative team
Establish a strong creative culture that encourages innovation, collaboration, and excellence
Define and drive the creative vision and overall creative direction for the EMEA market
Develop creative strategies aligned with brand objectives and business goals
Lead and oversee creative concepts, campaigns, and key projects, ensuring a consistently high level of output
Establish creative standards and ensure quality across all deliverables
Partner closely with marketing, brand, product, and business teams to deliver impactful creative solutions
Improve and optimize creative processes to enable efficient and effective ways of working
Support the professional growth and development of creative team members
Represent the Hungarian creative team in regional and global collaborations

What You’ll Bring

Extensive experience in a Creative Director, Associate Creative Director, or similar senior creative leadership role
Proven experience building and scaling creative teams
Strong strategic thinking combined with outstanding creative judgment
Ability to define creative vision, operating models, and team structures from the ground up
Strong understanding of brand building, campaigns, and creative strategy
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Ability to inspire, attract, and develop creative talent
Experience working in fast-paced, collaborative, and cross-functional environments

WE OFFER

Private health insurance and access to a range of healthcare and preventive services.
Sports & cultural benefits to support your wellbeing and work-life balance.
Dog-friendly office
Hybrid working policy
A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021.
Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHO ARE WE?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree required
5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred:

Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms
Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range: £92,000 GBP - £101,000 GBP

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™
and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

As Creative Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of performance marketing and our creative team, translating data into the stories, hooks, and formats that drive Yepoda's paid social growth. Your focus is to turn day-to-day performance metrics into actionable creative direction, keeping design, content, and influencer teams aligned on what's winning and why, while building the testing roadmaps that keep our creative pipeline ahead of platform trends.

Your Tasks

Deliver detailed, actionable creative briefs, direct-response copy, and frame-by-frame storyboards for the design team.
Monitor day-to-day micro-metrics (thumb-stop ratios, 3-second hold rates, CTR) to rapidly diagnose asset performance and propose modular iterations.
Act as the bridge between performance and creative by streamlining the asset request pipeline and managing the feedback loop between media buyers and designers.
Supply the in-house production and influencer teams with data-backed insights, winning hooks, and performance trends to guide their shoots.
Proactively design and build A/B testing roadmaps for new hooks, visual formats, and messaging angles.
Define and map specific creative concepts and angles to targeted consumer personas for both evergreen (BAU) and seasonal campaigns.
Spot native platform trends by maintaining a swipe file of Meta vs. TikTok content and mapping competitor strategies.
Present monthly reviews by synthesizing weekly learnings into macro-level creative presentations for stakeholders.
Own post-click/CRO alignment by auditing and advising on e-commerce landing pages to ensure the post-click experience matches the ad narrative.
Build secondary channel playbooks by adapting winning Meta/TikTok creatives for expansion channels like Pinterest, Snapchat, or Reddit.

Your Profile

4+ years of experience in a creative strategy or content strategy, ideally within a D2C or e-commerce brand and in touch with performance marketing.
Proven experience optimizing paid social creative assets for Meta and/or TikTok, with a strong understanding of how platform algorithms use creative signals to define audience targeting.
Comfortable working with performance data (thumb-stop ratios, hold rates, CTR) to diagnose what's working and translate it into new creative angles, not just report on it.
Experience writing creative briefs, scripts, or storyboards for a design team; visual production skills (e.g. Canva) are a plus but not required.
Strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable aligning performance marketing, design, content, and influencer teams around a shared creative direction.
Familiarity with workflow and creative analytics tools (e.g. Motion or similar).
Fluent in English; Italian or French language is a plus.

What we offer

Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.
Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.
Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.
Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.
We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.
Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!
Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

At Yepoda we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist, Growth Marketing, Milan (12-Month Contract)
jobs.description:
Description

Job Description

Join The Team Redefining How The World Experiences Design

Hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

This role is based in Milan, with a hybrid working arrangement. Our Milan hub is a place for collaboration and creative energy and we want you close enough to the Italian market to genuinely feel it. You'll have the flexibility to work in a way that suits you, with meaningful time in the office to connect with the team.

About The Role

As the Creative Strategist for Italy, you'll be the creative performance engine behind Canva's paid and organic marketing in the region — working at the intersection of data, storytelling, and cultural nuance to drive real user growth. This is a hands-on, insight-led role where local knowledge, analytical curiosity, and creative excellence drive outcomes. You won't manage a direct team, but you'll have real influence — over creative direction, agency partners, and the cross-functional teams who help bring ideas to life.

What You'll Do

Lead the creative flywheel — own the full creative cycle (research, briefing, production, editing, and analysis), driving sprint cycles with regional and global teams and developing testable ideas grounded in user insights
Analyse and optimise performance — dig into dashboards to spot winners, diagnose underperformance, and design creative tests, lift studies, and attribution experiments in close partnership with analytics teams
Lead organic and paid social creative strategy — define what high-performing creative looks like for Italian audiences across Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms, building content systems informed by performance data and local cultural moments
Own UGC, localisation, and market insight — brief and review creator content to ensure it's on-brand and platform-optimised, and bring genuine cultural fluency to every project
Work with in-house and agency teams — bridge external creative partners and internal stakeholders, working with media buyers, data science, the Europe Growth Marketing Lead, and agency partners across Brand, Product Growth, and Analytics
Support conversion across the funnel — contribute to CRO initiatives to make acquisition journeys seamless, engaging, and high-converting

What We're Looking For

You bring real, hands-on experience in creative strategy or performance marketing and you know what it takes to build creative that actually performs. You understand platform-native formats deeply, you're rigorous about testing, and you use data to sharpen your thinking rather than replace it. You have genuine knowledge of the Italian market — not surface-level familiarity — and you move comfortably between global teams, agency partners, and local execution. You're self-directed, collaborative, and you take ownership of outcomes.

You're Probably a Match If

You have extensive experience in growth marketing with a focus on creative strategy across paid and organic social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram)

jobs.description:
Own the AI video pipeline for a $1Billion+ brand. The media is already scaled — the constraint is creative that converts, on the feed and on the page.

Total Annual Package:
Up to AED 22,000/month (tax-free) + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base
Location:
Dubai, UAE (On-site) with relocation assistance and visa support
Growth path
from here is Senior AI Video Creator → Creative Lead. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.

We've been AI-first since December 2023:
In this role, tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance, Midjourney and Flux are part of the production workflow — not side experiments. AI gets you to footage faster; your judgment decides whether the hook works, the product looks real, the edit holds attention and the finished asset is ready to ship.

Role Overview

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring an AI Video Creator, reporting directly to the Director of Marketing. You will own AI video production across cold-traffic ads on Meta, TikTok and YouTube and product videos on Puffy.com, covering concept and script, image generation, motion, editing, compositing, colour and audio. This role exists to turn already-scaled media spend into creative that converts, building the production pipeline that carries a hook from script to shippable asset at volume without the craft slipping.

The Career Accelerator

You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.

The scope is scarce:
very few AI Video Creators get simultaneous ownership of video creative for both paid advertising and the product page. And a direct line to the Director of Marketing with no layers in between.
Your first 12 months:
build the prompt and reference library for character and material consistency. Produce direct-response ads at volume for Meta and TikTok cold prospecting, multiple concepts per week. Solve character consistency across shots, including AI-generated spokespeople delivering to camera. Produce realism-first product video for Puffy.com from real product photography. Get material behaviour right — foam that compresses under a hand and recovers on release, fabric that moves like fabric. Master the invisible edit, blending generated footage with stock and shot footage until the AI elements are indistinguishable. Read CTR, hold rates and drop-off points and iterate the hook against what audiences actually do. Shape the future of AI video at Puffy, where creative is the binding constraint on a media engine that is already scaled.

What Is In It For You

This isn't just another AI video role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.

1. Own the Entire Chain, Script to Shipped Asset

You concept it, generate it, cut it, score it, and ship it.
You design the visual worlds, control the motion, cut for retention, and layer the voiceover, music and sound design — no handoff, no queue, no waiting on someone else's render. You choose which model solves which production problem, and you decide when footage is strong enough to ship, when it needs post-production, and when the right call is to regenerate.
The standard is performance, not applause. Every asset is a hypothesis: with the broader marketing team, you review CTR, hold rates, drop-off points and on-page conversion, iterate the hook, and bring your cuts into review with the Director of Marketing.

2. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand

3. Experience a World-Class Lifestyle

Dubai offers a tax-free salary, world-class infrastructure, year-round sunshine, and a global lifestyle that most professionals only experience later in their careers. Your entire compensation package lands in your account — no deductions, no surprises.

4. Become the Creator Whose Work Decides Whether It Converts

In most companies, video people make things that look good and hope somebody tests them. Here, you're the person whose first 3 seconds decide whether a cold audience stops scrolling, and whose product clip decides whether a shopper believes what's on screen is what arrives in the box. When an ad drives outbound CTR but not orders, your read on where it broke — hook, promise, or landing experience, is the reason the next iteration wins. You'll build the judgment to tell shippable generated footage from footage a shopper quietly distrusts and the direct-response instinct for where proof lands in a 30-second ad and where it kills the momentum. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency turnaround time in front of you.

What You'll Need

Direct response portfolio
— You've created ads designed to drive action, not just entertain. Performance results are valued where available.
Character consistency work
— You can maintain coherent characters, environments and visual details across multiple generated shots.
AI video generation fluency
— Hands-on experience with tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance or similar. You understand that different models solve different production problems.
Strong AI image-generation fundamentals
— Midjourney, Flux or similar tools for building controlled visual starting points and references.
Post-production expertise
— Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci or similar. You're comfortable with compositing, colour grading, clean-up and upscaling.
Audio proficiency
— AI voice synthesis, music and sound design for performance creative.
Direct-response judgment
— You understand hooks, pacing, problem/solution structure, proof, offers and calls to action.
Production speed
— You can create and iterate multiple assets without treating every piece like a weeks-long production.
Quality judgment
— You know when generated footage is strong enough to ship, when it needs post-production and when the right decision is to regenerate it.

Good-to-Have

DTC or e-commerce performance marketing experience
Ads with measurable conversion results
Familiarity with creative testing frameworks
Experience creating video specifically for e-commerce product pages or other on-site conversion journeys

The Puffy DNA:

We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
Be the Owner:
We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
Execute with Urgency:
We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
Demand Excellence:
We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
Be AI-First:
Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
Go All-In:
When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.

Exzellentes Design Ist Das Fundament Unvergesslicher Brand Experiences.

Wir suchen kein Allround-Talent für alles, sondern ein visuelles Ausnahmetalent: Einen Associate Creative Director (ACD) Design, der herausragendes visuelles Handwerk (Graphic Design, Typografie, Branding-Systeme) mit starkem räumlichen Denken verbindet. Du bist ein Top-Designer im Herzen, denkst aber weit über die zweidimensionale Fläche hinaus. Du übersetzt Markenidentitäten in konsistente visuelle Welten, die sich nahtlos in den Raum, in temporäre Installationen, Retail-Konzepte und digitale Touchpoints übertragen lassen.

Präsenz & Flexibilität (On-Site In München)

Home-Office und mobiles Arbeiten sind bei uns gelebter Alltag und wir sind hier extrem flexibel aufgestellt. Da es sich hierbei jedoch um eine zentrale Führungsrolle handelt, suchen wir jemanden für unser Office in München. Als gestalterischer Lead erwarten wir deine regelmäßige, physische Präsenz vor Ort, um nah am Team zu sein, Co-Creation-Prozesse direkt zu begleiten und die kreative Kultur im Studio aktiv mitzuprägen.

Als erfahrener Lead verstehst du es, deine gestalterische Vision nicht nur selbst aufs Papier zu bringen, sondern auch ein interdisziplinäres Design-Team zu führen, zu inspirieren und die visuelle Qualität unserer Projekte auf das allerhöchste Level zu heben.

Bei Avantgarde arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Marke, Raum, Technologie und Strategie – gemeinsam mit Spezialist:innen aus den Bereichen Strategy & Konzept, Graphic Design, 3D/Architektur, Digital und Produktion.

Deine Aufgaben

Visuelle Richtungsweisung & Exzellenz: Du definierst und verantwortest die visuelle Leitidee und Designqualität für internationale Brands – vom ersten Pitch-Layout bis zur finalen Umsetzung im Raum.
Schnittstelle von Grafik und Raum: Du übersetzt komplexe Markenstrategien in herausragende visuelle Systeme, die im physischen und dreidimensionalen Kontext (Szenografie, Retail, Brand Spaces) perfekt funktionieren.
Teamführung & Mentoring: Du führst, inspirierst und entwickelst ein Team aus Designer:innen (Grafik, Motion, Spatial-Grafik). Dabei leitest du Junior- und Mid-Level-Kreative fachlich an und fördern eine Kultur des visuellen Anspruchs.
Interdisziplinäre Co-Creation: Als federführender kreativer Kopf arbeitest du auf Augenhöhe mit unseren Designer:innen, Architekt:innen und Konzepter:innen zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass visuelle Identität und physischer Raum eine perfekte Einheit bilden.
Projektverantwortung & Qualität: Du übernimmst die kreative Verantwortung für zentrale Großprojekte und Pitches, stellst die gestalterische Leitlinie sicher und hältst dabei Qualität, Zeit und Budget im Blick.
Souveränes Client-Facing: Du verpackst anspruchsvolle Design-Konzepte in überzeugende, visuell makellose Pitches, berätst unsere Kund:innen strategisch und präsentierst deine Ideen mit Charisma und klarer Argumentation.

Dein Profil

Räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen: Du liebst den Raum. Du kannst visuelle Konzepte dreidimensional denken und verstehst, wie Grafik, Licht, Material und Architektur zusammenspielen.

Konzeptionelle & strategische Tiefe: Du gestaltest nicht nur „schön“, sondern immer strategisch fundiert und basierend auf einem tiefen Verständnis für die Marke und deren Zielgruppe.
Challenger-Mindset & Souveränität: Du besitzt eine klare kreative Haltung, bist kommunikationsstark und hast den Mut sowie das Mindset, bestehende Meinungen und Briefings konstruktiv zu challengen, um das beste Ergebnis herauszuholen.

Was du mitbringst

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 8 Jahre) in einer Design-, Branding- oder Kreativagentur, mit klarem Fokus auf Brand Experience oder räumliche Inszenierung.
Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign, Visuelle Kommunikation oder eine vergleichbare, herausragende Qualifikation.
Einen hochprofessionellen Workflow in der Adobe Creative Cloud (idealerweise inklusive Basiswissen in Video-Editing/Animation) sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Generative AI-Tools für Bild- und Designprozesse.
Absolute Detailverliebtheit gepaart mit dem Blick für das große Ganze (Qualität, Timing und Budget).

jobs.title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
bei JUNGLÜCK gibst du unserer Marke eine starke Stimme. Du tauchst tief in die Welt unserer Zielgruppe ein, verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse, Träume und Zweifel und verwandelst diese Insights in ergebnisorientiertes und emotionales Storytelling für Ad Creatives, organischen Social-Content und Direct-Response-Landingpages mit Fokus auf Neukundenakquise.

Du verstehst, warum jemand in den ersten Sekunden eines Videos weiterschaut oder weiterscrollt, kennst die unterschiedlichen Ausgangslagen unserer Kundinnen – die 23-Jährige mit Unreinheiten, die 42-Jährige mit ersten Fältchen – und setzt konkrete Wirkmechanismen wie Hooks, Social Proof, Knappheit oder Preisanker gezielt ein. Am Ende stehen exzellente Copies, Skripte und Konzepte für Ads, Reels sowie Direct-Response-Landingpages.

Ad Angle-Backlog & Skripte: Du verantwortest den Angle-Backlog, welche Kaufmotivation wir ansprechen, mit welchem Argument, mit welcher Botschaft auf welcher Funnel-Stufe, in welchem Format und schreibst daraus Ad-Skripte in hoher Schlagzahl, die Viralität, Kaufmotive und Direct Response aktivieren und Einwände aushebeln, bevor sie überhaupt entstehen.
Organische Reichweite: Wir wollen unsere organische Reichweite in den nächsten 12 Monaten auf 2 Mio. Views/Monat ver-20-fachen. Du schreibst die Reel-Konzepte, die diese Reichweite erst ermöglichen und denkst dabei Paid und Organic von Anfang an zusammen
Trendscouting als Input für Konzepte: Du bist im Feed zuhause und beobachtest aktiv Format- und Trendentwicklungen auf TikTok, Instagram und Meta. Du übersetzt das frühzeitig in konkrete Angle- und Skript-Ideen, bringst dabei immer auch eigene kreative Ideen ein und arbeitest eng mit dem Influencer-Marketing-Team zusammen, um Trend-Insights und Learnings zwischen Ads/Organic und Creator-Content auszutauschen.
Testing & Diagnose: Du entwickelst und führst strukturierte Testing-Frameworks durch und liest anhand klarer KPIs direkt ab, wieso eine Ad, ein Reel oder eine Direct-Response-Landingpage (nicht) funktioniert. Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CVR, CPA, CAC und ihre Zusammenhänge fließen in deine Iterationen und neuen Konzepte ein.
Creative-Strategie & Produktion leiten: Du schreibst Briefings für UGC-Creator, Videografen und Editoren, die so präzise sind, dass ohne Rückfrage gearbeitet werden kann.
Skalierbare, KI-gestützte Workflows aufbauen und nutzen: Du nutzt KI Tools, die dein Iterationstempo und Volumen erhöhen, und bereicherst den Output im Anschluss mit deiner eigenen Handschrift.

Das steckt in deiner Haut

Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Creative Strategist, Creative Copywriter oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Performance Marketing, idealerweise im E-Commerce- oder D2C-Umfeld
Exzellentes Verständnis der psychologischen Trigger unserer Kundinnen und ihrer Kaufentscheidungen – ohne Psychologiestudium, aber mit der Fähigkeit, das in Copies, Skripte, Konzepte zu übersetzen
Ausgeprägtes Sprach- und Storytellinggefühl sowie hoher Qualitätsanspruch an die eigene Schreibe. Du nutzt KI-Tools als Tempo-Hebel, aber deine Texte sind niemals AI-Slop
Außergewöhnliches Gespür für kreative Werbekonzepte und virale Social-Media-Inhalte, für Paid wie für Organic
Tiefes Verständnis aktueller Trends auf TikTok, Instagram, Facebook und YouTube
Strategisches Denken sowie die Fähigkeit, kreative Prozesse und Schnittstellen effizient zu steuern
Hohe Eigenverantwortung und ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität
Sicherer Umgang mit Creative KPIs und Performance-Daten (u. a. Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CVR, ROAS, CAC)
Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und schnelle Arbeitsweise
Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau

Deine Benefits: We care for you

Werde Teil eines aufgeschlossenen Teams mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
Bei uns kannst du von Tag Eins an Verantwortung übernehmen und Deine eigenen Ideen vorantreiben
Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche sowie Umfragen, um das Arbeitsumfeld und die Unternehmenskultur stetig zu verbessern
Arbeite so, wie Du am produktivsten bist; profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, gelegentlich aus dem Homeoffice zu arbeiten
Bleibe aktiv! Bei uns erhältst Du eine Bezuschussung zu Deiner EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft
Kümmere Dich um Dein mentales Wohlbefinden: Nutze die Möglichkeit Dir über OpenUp Online-Sitzungen mit ausgebildeten Psycholog*innen zu buchen sowie an zahlreichen Workshops und Webinaren teilzunehmen
Wir fördern den Teamspirit mit regelmäßigen Events und schaffen vielerlei Gelegenheiten zum Austausch untereinander
Natürlich gibt es bei uns auch einen Mitarbeiter*innen-Rabatt auf JUNGLÜCK-Produkte, außerdem erhältst Du Zugänge zu Plattformen, die Dir Vergünstigungen bei weiteren (nachhaltigen) Unternehmen bieten
Begleite uns auf unserer Mission, den Kosmetikmarkt nachhaltiger, transparenter und sozialer zu gestalten
Und das Beste: ein tolles Team, das Dich herzlich aufnimmt!

Kontakt

Konnten wir Dein Interesse wecken? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen inkl. CV sowie der Angabe Deines frühestmöglichen Startdatums und Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

Unser Interviewprozess:

Dich erwarten folgende Schritte:

Erstes Gespräch mit Jana, People & Culture (30-40 min)
Fachliches Interview mit Hannah, Head of Performance Marketing (45-60 min)
Bearbeitung einer Case Study zu Hause und anschließende Vorstellung der Ergebnisse (Präsentation ca. 45-60 min)
Teamkennenlernen mit zukünftigen Kolleg*innen (ca. 30 min)
Ein Angebot und Dein Vertrag warten auf Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Dein Onboarding!

Über uns

JUNGLÜCK ist 2018 aus einer persönlichen Beobachtung entstanden. Gründer Benedikt Klarmann sah, dass die Frauen in seinem Leben mit ihrer Kosmetik unglücklich waren. Nicht wegen mangelnder Auswahl, sondern wegen mangelnder Substanz. Es gab zu viele Versprechen, zu wenig Wirkung. Zu viele schlechte Inhaltsstoffe, zu wenig Reinheit.

Die Frage lautete: Kann man das nicht anders besser machen?

Aus dieser Frage ist JUNGLÜCK geworden. Und sie treibt uns bis heute an: Wissenschaftlich geprüfte, wirksame Rezepturen, rein formuliert, ohne falsche Versprechen und ohne unnötige Komplexität. Eine Marke, die Frauen hilft, sich dauerhaft in ihrer Haut glücklich zu fühlen.

jobs.title: FE Design Agentic AI Automation Expert
jobs.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.

YOUR ROLE

At STMicroelectronics, we are accelerating the adoption of Agentic and Generative AI
to fundamentally transform semiconductor engineering workflows. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the introduction of LLM‑powered, agentic AI systems
into Front‑End (FE) digital design environments.

Your primary mission is to design, develop, and industrialize agentic AI solutions
capable of reasoning, planning, and acting across complex engineering workflows. These solutions will connect knowledge bases, design guidelines, EDA tools, and automated checks
to deliver guided automation, embedded quality guardrails, and measurable improvements in productivity and design quality.

You will work in close collaboration with digital design experts to ensure that AI agents are effectively grounded in FE design practices and can scale to industrial‑grade usage across ST design teams and sites.

Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

Lead the design and deployment of agentic AI and LLM‑based systems for engineering workflows.
Develop AI agents capable of reasoning, task orchestration, tool invocation, and workflow automation.
Integrate LLM‑based agents with internal knowledge bases, coding/design guidelines, and EDA environments.
Define architectures for human‑in‑the‑loop AI systems with embedded quality, safety, and traceability.
Collaborate with design and methodology teams to ground AI solutions in real FE digital design use cases.
Contribute to the definition of metrics to assess impact on productivity, design cycle time, and quality.
Participate in the evaluation of internal and external AI and EDA technology solutions.
Support the industrialization, scalability, and governance of AI solutions in engineering environments.

YOUR SKILLS & EXPERIENCES Primary skills – Agentic AI & Software Engineering

Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
Strong experience in AI/ML and Generative AI, with clear exposure to LLMs and agentic AI systems.
Practical experience with:
Agent architectures (tool‑using agents, planners, multi‑agent or workflow‑driven systems)
Prompt engineering, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and AI orchestration frameworks

Strong software engineering skills (Python, APIs, workflow integration, automation).
Ability to design robust, explainable, and scalable AI systems for industrial environments.
Experience integrating AI solutions with existing tools and complex enterprise systems.

Secondary Skills – Digital Design Domain Knowledge

Good understanding of digital front‑end design principles (RTL design, structural checks, design quality).
Familiarity with EDA tool environments and design workflows is a strong asset.
Ability to work closely with design and verification teams to translate domain needs into AI capabilities.
Interest in applying AI to engineering productivity, quality, and design robustness.

Additional Qualifications

Strong analytical mindset with focus on measurable impact.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work in international, multi‑site teams.
Autonomous, proactive, and comfortable working at the intersection of AI research and industrial deployment.
Fluent business English (spoken and written).

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.

new_jobs.title: Senior Strategist (Brand & Creative)
new_jobs.description:
Boldspace are looking for someone with a strong track record in brand and integrated creative strategy, able to guide creative thinking, shape strategic direction for clients, and lead integrated strategic processes from insight through to execution. You should be comfortable acting as a trusted voice to clients and internal teams alike, helping define challenges, uncover opportunities, and develop work that delivers meaningful commercial and brand impact. A background spanning both brand and creative strategy is preferred, though not essential.

ABOUT BOLDSPACE

Boldspace is a brand value & creative agency. We help organisations grow their meaning, reputation and value through brand building, communications and analytics.

At our core is a combination of strategic thinking and creative advisory, helping clients move into new territory through brand campaigns that spark conversations and build reputation with the audiences that matter most. We are passionate about helping brands find their bold space: the unique territory where they are relevant, their audience cares, and they have the right to lead.

Since launch in 2020, our blend of strategy, creativity and technology has delivered positive impact for a diverse set of clients, including the Post Office, VISA, TGI Fridays, Deel, Virgin, Direct Line, Lovehoney, Boylesports and many more.

We are also the creators of Boldstream, our proprietary agentic AI SaaS platform designed for modern marketing and communications teams. Boldstream combines multi-LLM technology, integrated data and more than 100 specialist AI agents to support strategy, creativity, content and communications workflows in one connected system. The platform is used by live customers as well as internally by our own teams to help deliver smarter, faster and more effective work.

REQUIREMENTS

Lead strategic direction

Understand client businesses, audiences and objectives to help define clear strategic opportunities and solutions
Lead strategic thinking across accounts, helping shape both long-term brand direction and campaign development
Take ownership of strategic processes from briefing through to delivery and evaluation
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, building confidence through clear thinking, strong communication and commercial understanding
Identify opportunities for client and account growth, and contribute proactively to wider business development conversations
Set clear KPIs and success measures for strategic and creative work

Develop insight-driven thinking

Use a combination of quantitative and qualitative inputs to uncover meaningful insights and inform strategic recommendations
Be fluent in interpreting audience, cultural and market signals to shape compelling strategic responses
Lead stakeholder conversations and workshops that help uncover opportunities, align teams and inspire creative development
Stay informed on cultural, category and behavioural trends, translating these into relevant and actionable thinking for clients

new_jobs.title: AI Creative Specialist | jij maakt beeld en video met de blik van een fotograaf | 2 vacatures
new_jobs.description:
Vacatureomschrijving

Je ziet wanneer het licht niet klopt. Wanneer een stof te glad oogt, een schoen zijn vorm verliest of een camerabeweging onnatuurlijk voelt. En je kunt uitleggen wat er moet veranderen om het beeld wél te laten werken.

Als AI Creative Specialist bij Omoda Brands gebruik je die vakkennis om foto- en videocontent met AI te produceren. Je helpt onze AI-productie opzetten: van productreferentie en briefing tot een consistente serie beelden die past bij het product, het kanaal en het merk.

Wat een AI Specialist Creatie bij ons is

Je combineert kennis van fotografie en visuele productie met praktisch gebruik van generatieve AI. Je begrijpt hoe een goed beeld wordt opgebouwd en kunt die keuzes vertalen naar referenties, instructies, instellingen en nabewerking.

Je maakt zelf content met AI en beoordeelt het resultaat. Belichting, perspectief, compositie, styling en materiaalweergave zijn voor jou concrete middelen om een beeld te sturen.

We maken al productbeelden met AI. Jij helpt ons om reproduceerbare productiewerkwijzes te maken voor Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com. Daarbij bewaak je het eigen karakter van ieder merk, binnen de bestaande creatieve richting.

Wat je doet

Je produceert met AI beeld- en videocontent voor onder meer productpresentaties, outfits, interieurs en campagnes.
Je vertaalt briefings en merkrichtlijnen naar concrete keuzes in licht, compositie, achtergrond, styling, kadrering en beweging.
Je selecteert geschikte productbeelden en visuele referenties en bepaalt welke input nodig is om een betrouwbaar resultaat te krijgen.
Je werkt met bestaande AI-tools, stuurt de generatie gericht bij en combineert die waar nodig met fotografie, retouche en montage.
Je controleert of het product herkenbaar en correct blijft: kleur, vorm, verhoudingen, materiaal, prints, logo’s en details moeten overeenkomen met de referentie.
Je beoordeelt beelden op fotografische kwaliteit en merkstijl en corrigeert afwijkingen voordat ze worden aangeboden voor publicatie.
Je let bij video op natuurlijke beweging, montage en continuïteit: een product, persoon of kledingstuk moet gedurende de opname consistent blijven.
Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare werkwijzen, referentiesets en instellingen waarmee je ook een volgende serie op hetzelfde kwaliteitsniveau kunt maken.
Je legt vast hoe content tot stand komt en helpt collega’s met de werkwijze en kwaliteitscontrole.
Je test nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen concrete producties en beoordeelt of ze bruikbare kwaliteit en tijdwinst opleveren.

Een aantrekkelijk beeld moet ook het juiste product laten zien. Je herkent wanneer extra nabewerking, een andere aanpak of aanvullende fotografie nodig is.

Functie-eisen

Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com hebben ieder een eigen uitstraling en doelgroep. Jij kunt die verschillen herkennen en vertalen naar de content die je maakt.

Je werkt vanuit de creatieve kaders van het betreffende merk en stemt af met de betrokken creatieve collega’s. Je bewaakt dat een serie samenhangend blijft, ook wanneer er meerdere producten, formaten of varianten worden gemaakt.

Je kijkt daarbij zowel naar het afzonderlijke beeld als naar het geheel: klopt de stijl op een productpagina, binnen een campagne en naast de andere content van het merk?

Wat je meebrengt

Je hebt een stevige basis in professionele fotografie of visuele productie, bijvoorbeeld als fotograaf, retoucher, beeldmaker of artdirector met praktische productie-ervaring.
Je begrijpt belichting, compositie, perspectief, kleur en materiaalweergave en kunt benoemen waarom een beeld wel of niet werkt.
Je hebt ervaring met product-, fashion- of lifestylebeelden en kunt werken binnen verschillende merkstijlen.
Je hebt zelf beelden gemaakt met generatieve AI en kunt laten zien hoe je het resultaat hebt gestuurd en verbeterd.
Je beheerst beeldbewerking en retouche, bijvoorbeeld in Photoshop of vergelijkbare software.
Je hebt gevoel voor bewegend beeld en kunt onnatuurlijke bewegingen, montageproblemen en inconsistenties herkennen. Praktische ervaring met videoproductie of montage is een plus.
Je werkt nauwkeurig en kunt een goed resultaat vertalen naar een werkwijze die opnieuw bruikbaar is.
Voor deze functie is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal vereist.

Je hoeft niet ieder AI-model of iedere tool te kennen. We zoeken iemand die weet wat goede fotografie en video zijn en die met AI kan leren realiseren. Je portfolio en inhoudelijke oordeel wegen zwaar. Programmeren is geen vereiste.

Aanvullende informatie

Je team

Je maakt deel uit van het AI-team en werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit creatie, fotografie, studio, content en de verschillende merken. Jij brengt het fotografische en creatieve vakmanschap en ontwikkelt de praktische werkwijze in de beschikbare tools. Voor maatwerksoftware, complexe automatisering of technische integraties werk je samen met AI Product Builders en AI Engineers.

Over Omoda Brands

Omoda Brands is het huis achter Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com. Vier merken, ruim 2.000 collega’s en meer dan 3 miljoen klanten per jaar. Onze ambitie is de meest persoonlijke boutique op schaal. Beeld helpt klanten daarbij: het laat zien hoe een product eruitziet, hoe je het combineert en hoe het past in je leven. We maken al productbeelden met AI en willen die productie verder ontwikkelen. Jij helpt ons foto- en videocontent maken die aantrekkelijk, productgetrouw en herkenbaar is voor ieder merk.

Wat je bij ons vindt

Flexibel werken vanuit Zierikzee, Amsterdam of Zwolle. We komen gemiddeld 1 à 2 dagen per week samen op één van deze locaties.
32–38 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw voorkeur.
Een passend salaris op basis van jouw kennis, ervaring en de waarde die je meebrengt.
De kans om AI-productie voor vier bekende merken op te gaan zetten.
Concrete producten, creatieve briefings en beeldmateriaal om mee te werken.
Ruimte om je fotografische vakkennis toe te passen op nieuwe productiemethoden.
Samenwerking met creatieve collega’s en technische specialisten.
Zichtbaar werk dat klanten helpt producten te ontdekken en te kiezen.

Interesse?

Laat ons zien wat je hebt gemaakt en vooral hoe je daartoe kwam. Deel enkele relevante beelden of video’s, waaronder een voorbeeld waarin je AI hebt gebruikt. Wat was de briefing, wat was jouw eigen bijdrage en hoe stuurde je op fotografische kwaliteit, productgetrouwheid en merkstijl?

We zien graag hoe je van referentie of eerste versie naar het uiteindelijke resultaat kwam. Een compact portfolio, link of voor-en-na-voorbeeld is voldoende; in het gesprek gaan we er samen dieper op in. Je hoeft geen nieuwe opdracht voor je sollicitatie te maken of vertrouwelijk materiaal te delen.

new_jobs.title: Creative Strategist
new_jobs.description:
Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben.
Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm
). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet
.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du willst in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas mit überzeugenden Creatives dazu beitragen, die Brücke zwischen klinischer Forschung und überzeugenden Botschaften für Patientinnen zu schlagen? Dich treibt die Frage um, warum bestimmte Gesundheitsbotschaften wirken, und du bist bereit, Ownership für die Insights und Prozesse zu übernehmen, die unsere gesamte Creative-Pipeline optimieren? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir suchen ab sofort einen Creative Strategist (w/m/d) für Kijimea. Du wirst Teil eines Teams, das Klarheit, Wissenschaft und Kundenverhalten konsequent in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Gemeinsam erschließen wir neue Wachstumschancen, indem wir kreative Konzepte systematisch testen und unsere Position als vertrauenswürdigste, datengetriebene Marke in der Kategorie Verdauungsgesundheit weiter ausbauen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du führst quantitative sowie qualitative Markt- und Zielgruppenanalysen durch, um Präferenzen, Motive und Bedürfnisse der Zielgruppen fundiert zu verstehen.
Du schreibst Direct-Response-Skripte für den Bereich Video-Content und nutzt dabei Storytelling-Elemente, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erzeugen und überzeugend zu argumentieren.
Du erstellst klare, datenbasierte Briefings für unsere Agenturpartner, damit überzeugender Content entsteht
Du tauchst tief in Performance-Daten ein und identifizierst, warum ein Creative gewonnen oder verloren hat – ob Hook, medizinischer Claim oder visuelles Format – und spielst die Learnings direkt in die Produktion zu-rück.
Du bringst proaktiv Ideen ein, die unsere Online-Kampagnenziele unterstützen und sich stringent in die Gesamtstrategie einfügen.

Dein Profil

Du hast ein Studium oder eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung z.B. im Bereich Kommunikationswissenschaften, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Journalismus oder Marketing.
Du konntest bereits mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrungen im Bereich Creative Strategy sammeln (idealerweise in einer Agentur oder in einem Start-/Scale-up) und möchtest deine Skills nun bei einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare Player weltweit einbringen und weiter ausbauen.
Du verstehst, dass Content auf Plattformen wie Meta oder Youtube ein entscheidender Performance Treiber ist und brennst dafür, neue Formate und Angles zu entwickeln und zu testen
Du arbeitest datenbasiert und gehst analytisch ins Detail; seien es kommerzielle KPI wie ROAS oder CPO, oder auch Klick-, Hook- oder Engagement Rates
Du arbeitest äußerst strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig.
Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Level) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2-Level).

Unser Versprechen

Wir bieten Dir einen vielfältigen, anspruchsvollen Job mit spannenden Aufgaben und einem breiten Spektrum an Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten! Unser innovatives Umfeld ermöglicht Dir Deine berufliche Entfaltung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, Verantwortung von Tag 1 an und den Freiraum, neue Wege zu gehen. Auf Dich wartet individuelles Learning und echte Sinnhaftigkeit – schenke mit Deinem persönlichen Beitrag Millionen von Menschen ein neues Leben!
